*   `?g D8`: Main Concept is `D8` (Time / Duration).
    *   `+ A12`: Part of Main Concept is `A12` (Ground transportation / Road).
    *   `+ B1`: Part of Main Concept is `B1` (Human / Society / Group).
    *   `!r D3`: Red Sub-Concept (feature/related) is `D3` (Fast / Race).
    *   `+ A12`: Red Sub-Concept is `A12` (Ground transportation / Road).
    *   `!y D8`: Yellow Sub-Concept (feature/related) is `D8` (Time / Duration).

    *   The core concept (`?g`) is Time/Duration.
    *   The main concept involves Road/Transportation and People/Society.
    *   The red clue (detail/feature) highlights Speed/Racing and Road/Transportation.
    *   The yellow clue (detail/feature) reinforces Time/Duration.

    *   *Idea 1: A race.* (Matches D3 Fast, A12 Road, D8 Time).
    *   *Idea 2: A commute.* (Matches A12 Road, D8 Time, B1 Human/Society).
    *   *Idea 3: Traffic jam.* (Matches A12 Road, B1 People/Society, D8 Time (duration of waiting), but D3 is "Fast/Race" which is the opposite).
    *   *Idea 4: Formula 1 or Grand Prix.* (Matches D3 Fast, A12 Road/Track, B1 Society/Group (teams), D8 Time/Duration).
    *   *Idea 5: A trip or journey.* (Matches A12 Road, D8 Time, B1 People).
    *   *Idea 6: A marathon?* (Usually running, not A12 Road/Transportation).
    *   *Idea 7: Speed limit?* (Matches A12 Road, D8 Time/Duration (implied speed), D3 Fast).
    *   *Idea 8: A car race.*

    *   `?g D8` (Time/Duration) suggests the subject is "a period of time" or "a time-related thing".
    *   `+ A12` (Road) + `+ B1` (People) -> Travel/Commuting/Driving.
    *   `!r D3` (Fast) + `+ A12` (Road) -> Racing/Speeding.
    *   `!y D8` (Time) -> Duration/Timeframe.
